lead: Om Puri was an Indian film actor, born on 18 October 1949 in Ambala.
He died on 6 January 2017 in Mumbai at the age of 67.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Officer of the Order of the British Empire and Padma Shri in arts.
This profile collects the Om facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Om Puri — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Om Puri was born on 18 October 1949 in Ambala, and holds Indian nationality. He was given the name ਓਮ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਪੁਰੀ at birth and is publicly known as Om Puri.
He received his education at Film and Television Institute of India and National School of Drama.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi and English.
